technical.summary: Extreme oversold conditions with early momentum recovery signals are offset by pervasive bearish price structure, negative volume metrics, and lack of moving average confirmation—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: EIX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 30 days adds timing risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (33/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but absent congressional conviction and unavailable news sentiment limit conviction; neutral AAII backdrop suggests mixed positioning.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (381.76) with imminent FOMC event in 1 day creates severe near-term volatility risk; utilities defensive characteristics offer limited protection in acute panic conditions; earnings in 30 days adds secondary binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold RSI conditions (9 and 14) with StochRSI crossover and fear-zone contrarian opportunity present classic reversal setup in defensive utility sector.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive bearish structure (price below all key moving averages, negative MACD/OBV/CMF, no MA confirmation), VIX crisis regime with imminent FOMC event in 1 day, high earnings risk in 30 days, and zero fundamental conviction create unacceptable risk/reward for swing entry.

decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis regime (381.76) with FOMC event in 1 day creates acute volatility spike risk that overshadows oversold technicals; existing 31 Utilities positions and pre-existing EIX holding create concentration drag.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bear case
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding EIX with 31 open Utilities positions (26% of portfolio); adding to concentration in fear-driven environment violates risk management discipline.
